active_phase.immediate_objective: Bring the versioned Archetype-A reference fixture docs/ui/fixtures/op-detail-compacto/OP Detail - Compacto.dc.html into conformance with the canonical visual foundation, changing visual values and structural conformance only and preserving the already approved compact geometry. EXACTLY TWO IMPLEMENTATION PATHS CHANGED: the fixture and the new tests/ui-op-detail-compacto-fixture.test.mjs. css/tokens.css, UI_VISUAL_CONTRACT.md, DESIGN_DECISIONS.md, support.js, docs/ui/evidence/**, assets/brand/**, js/**, db/**, index.html, css/responsive.css, scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs, scripts/ui-foundation/** and tests/manta-route-ui.smoke.js are byte-identical to f3ff4cb. NO token was invented or added and NO new design decision was required. STYLESHEET: the fixture loads the versioned token owner exactly once via ../../../../css/tokens.css, the only local stylesheet; no token declaration was copied in, no second token stylesheet exists, and there is no dependency on .claude, on the external intake directory or on application runtime. VALUES: literal colours 201 to 0 in all eight prohibited CSS forms; 276 var(--rv-*) references over 45 distinct canonical tokens, all resolving; zero deprecated references, so no --rv-status-* or --rv-color-* name appears. Text collapsed onto the four canonical levels only, with --rv-text-title on the 22px H1 alone; --rv-text-on-brand gains its first runtime consumer, closing the intake's disclosed declared-but-unconsumed state. One family per element for stage, status pill, count pill and bare signals; brand teal remains unused so its logo, login and print scope is intact. RADIUS: every border-radius is var(--rv-radius) or var(--rv-radius-pill). HEIGHTS: the three-rung ladder is expressed through tokens and not flattened, measured live at 34/34/34, 38 and 32/32/32. SHADOWS: all eight cards declare var(--rv-shadow-none) explicitly and the fios banner declares var(--rv-shadow-sm); --rv-shadow-popover is unused because the fixture has no popover. MARKERS: the root carries data-ui-archetype='detail-cockpit' and the Entregas empty-state-plus-action row carries data-card-actions with space-between, a border-top of 1px solid var(--rv-border-soft) and padding-top 11px; the rail action and the three dashed attach buttons are the two sanctioned full-width exceptions and are deliberately not marked. GEOMETRY PRESERVED, MEASURED at 1440x900 and 1600x1000: header 60, sidebar 190, rail 300, content max 1600, main padding 18px 32px 40px, card padding 15px 17px, 15px 17px 6px and 16px 17px, stack gap 14, column gap 16, rail sticky at top 0, eight cards in the unchanged order, zero native select, no horizontal page overflow, and table header widths equal to their value widths in all three tables. Each shell value is now written through its token. Intrinsic card heights measured 1-5px shorter than baseline; this was chased to a conclusion, not waved through - restoring in the live DOM every layout-capable property the edit touched produced byte-identical heights, and the control is the H1, whose only change was colour and which therefore cannot change height yet measured 26px in the baseline session and 27px after, so the two measurement sessions differ in font-metric state. VALUE-ONLY PROOF: a normalised projection of tags, non-style attributes, text nodes and ordered CSS property names per element was diffed across 762 projected lines; no text node, copy string, tag, section, table column or non-style attribute changed. An interaction-scope regression was caught and reverted during execution: a hover had been added to the primary rail button that the baseline did not have. TEST: tests/ui-op-detail-compacto-fixture.test.mjs, 21 tests passing, deliberately fixture-specific and explicitly NOT the phase-4 general detector; it reuses scripts/ui-foundation/token-parser.mjs and inventory.mjs rather than reimplementing parsing, covers all seventeen required assertions plus distinct chip glyphs, absence of emoji and section-label order, and includes two negative cases proving the literal-colour matcher and the marker scan are not vacuous. VALIDATION: node scripts/validate-ui-foundation.mjs -> PASS errors=0 debt=335, exactly the required result; node --test tests/ui-foundation-validator.test.mjs -> 31/31; node --test tests/*.js -> 4326 tests, 4325 pass / 1 fail, the sole failure the accepted external-corpus tests/g14-c-bridge-smoke.test.js at its byte-for-byte baseline; git diff --check clean. RUNTIME: all local requests 200 including css/tokens.css and the brand logo, no missing local dependency, no blocking console error, no clipping, no overlapping control. A defect found during validation was NOT the fixture: a stale browser cache entry for /css/tokens.css left by a different project on the same local port was served instead of the repository file, making every token appear unresolved; a cache-bypassing fetch proved the fixture depends on the canonical file rather than on any copied value. THREE DEVIATIONS ARE DISCLOSED FOR RULING: var(--rv-radius-pill) applied to circular indicators that are not literally status, stage or count pills, because D6 ratifies 999px as rendering identically to 50% and var(--rv-radius) would turn round indicators into rounded squares; the 'PDF de compra' link left in the Insumos section header because it is a navigation link and relocating it would change layout composition; and the status pill keeping its borderless padding 3px 9px construction rather than contract 2.6's 18px bordered form, because that is geometry this order froze. Screenshot evidence is stored outside the repository and is incomplete because the browser pane was intermittently not compositing; the quantitative measurements stand as the primary evidence. Architect VISUAL acceptance is NOT claimed. PHASE 4 NOT STARTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED - the detector must not be implemented or run. PHASE 5 NOT STARTED. Archetype A is NOT ratified by one screen: a second conforming screen, candidate OP Acabamento - Aberta.dc.html, and a detector run are both still required. Archetypes B-F remain CANDIDATE and may not be cited as precedent. The executor does not self-accept and no phase chains automatically. The superseded intake objective is not repeated here; docs/ledgers/G28_LEDGER.md owns the full historical record and last_accepted.ui_foundation_acceptance_note owns the acceptance ruling.
